async_thumbnails.description: Whether to download thumbnails asynchronously. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --async-thumbnails.

audio_pref.description: Audio format preference for ytdl. Maps to --audio-pref.

audio_shortcut.description: Shortcut for audio only action. Maps to audio_shortcut.

detach_shortcut.description: Shortcut for detach action. Maps to detach_shortcut.

download_shortcut.description: Shortcut for download action. Maps to download_shortcut.

enable_actions.description: Whether to enable actions. 0: disable, 1: enable. Maps to --disable-actions.

enable_back_button.description: Whether to enable the back button. 0: disable, 1: enable. Maps to --disable-back.

enable_submenus.description: Whether to enable submenus. 0: disable, 1: enable. Maps to --disable-submenus.

extensions.description: List of extensions to load. Maps to load_extension directives.

fancy_subs.description: Whether to have separators between subscriptions. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --fancy-subs.

features.description: Comma-separated features to filter by. Maps to --features.

force_invidious.description: Force invidious links with youtube scraper. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --force-invidious.

force_youtube.description: Force youtube links with youtube scraper. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --force-youtube.

format_selection_screen.description: Format selection screen type. Options: normal, simple. Maps to --format-selection.

format_selection_sort.description: Format sort for ytdl. Maps to --format-sort.

fzf_preview_side.description: Preview side in fzf. Options: left, right, up, down. Maps to --preview-side.

info_shortcut.description: Shortcut for info action. Maps to info_shortcut.

info_wait.description: Wait after printing info. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --info-wait.

info_wait_action.description: Action when info-wait is enabled. Options: link, video-json, json, format, raw. Maps to --info-action.

interface.description: Interface type. 'fzf' for fzf, 'ext' for external menu (default dmenu). Maps to --interface/-i or --external-menu/-D.

interfaces.description: List of custom interfaces to load. Maps to load_interface directives.

is_audio_only.description: Whether to play audio only. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --audio-only/-m.

is_detach.description: Whether to detach the video player. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --detach.

is_download.description: Whether to download selected videos. 0: play, 1: download. Maps to --download/-d.

is_loop.description: Whether to loop the menu. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --loop/-l.

is_sort.description: Whether to sort videos by upload date. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --sort.

keep_cache.description: Whether to keep cache. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --keep-cache.

keep_vars.description: Whether to keep vars in submenus. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --keep-vars.

link_count.description: Number of videos to select with auto-select. Maps to --link-count/-n.

max_thread_count.description: Max threads for scraping. Maps to --max-threads.

multi_search.description: Whether to use multi search. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --multi-search.

next_page_action_shortcut.description: Shortcut for next page action. Maps to next_page_action_shortcut.

notify_playing.description: Whether to show notifications. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --notify-playing.

nsfw.description: Whether to search for nsfw videos (Odysee). 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --nsfw.

odysee_video_search_count.description: Amount of videos to scrape on odysee. Maps to --odysee-video-count.

pages_start.description: Page to start scraping on. Maps to --pages-start.

pages_to_scrape.description: Amount of pages to scrape. Maps to --pages.

print_link_shortcut.description: Shortcut for print link action. Maps to print_link_shortcut.

scrapers.description: Comma-separated list of scrapers to use. Maps to -c/--scrape.

search_again.description: Whether to search again after closing fzf. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --search-again/-s.

search_again_shortcut.description: Shortcut for search again action. Maps to search_again_shortcut.

search_source.description: Source for search query. Options: args, prompt, hist. Maps to -q/--search-source.

show_formats_shortcut.description: Shortcut for show formats action. Maps to show_formats_shortcut.

show_thumbnails.description: Whether to show thumbnails. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --show-thumbnails/-t.

skip_thumb_download.description: Whether to skip thumbnail download. 0: off, 1: on. Maps to --skip-thumb-download.

sort_by.description: Sort by criteria. Options: relevance, rating, upload_date, oldest_first, view_count. Maps to --sort-by.

submenu_opts.description: Options to use in submenus. Maps to --submenu-opts.

thumbnail_quality.description: Thumbnail quality. Options: maxres, maxresdefault, sddefault, high, medium, default, start, middle, end. Maps to --thumbnail-quality.

thumbnail_viewers.description: List of thumbnail viewers to load. Maps to load_thumbnail_viewer directives.

type.description: Type of results. Options: video, playlist, channel, all. Maps to --type.

upload_date.description: Upload date time-frame. Options: hour, today, week, month, year. Maps to --upload-date.

url_handler_opts.description: Options to pass to url handler (e.g. mpv flags). Maps to --url-handler-opts.

url_handlers.description: List of url handlers to load. Maps to load_url_handler directives.

video_duration.description: Video duration filter. Options: short, long. Maps to --video-duration.

video_pref.description: Video format preference for ytdl. Maps to --video-pref.

video_shortcut.description: Shortcut for watch video action. Maps to video_shortcut.

ytdl_path.description: Path to youtube-dl or fork. Maps to --ytdl-path.

ytdl_pref.description: General ytdl format preference. Maps to --ytdl-pref.
